features: Remove the standalone manual rule-entry form and its creation/submission JavaScript; keep saved-version research tuning
Hide the unused legacy cloud builder in personal mode without leaving an empty form panel
Local-owner strategy and paper-account DELETE endpoints requiring CSRF and an explicit confirm=true body
Account deletion atomically removes holdings, fills, equity, schedule, admitted symbols and its execution heartbeat; no brokerage orders
Strategy deletion requires removing linked paper accounts and completing running backtests; queued/completed jobs are removed with the strategy
Pending/running AI requests block strategy deletion instead of changing approved input
Research conversations and ID tombstones retained, selected deleted strategy cleared, deleted executable reply removed; surviving version numbers remain monotonic
Deleted experiment candidates invalidate comparisons so those experiments cannot deploy remaining candidates as validated
Replaying an old deployment request cannot recreate a deleted account
Confirmation UI, double-click suppression, post-delete fresh GET, history-dialog closure, asset versions updated

owning_checks: HTTP owner isolation, CSRF, confirmation-body validation and local-only guards
Ledger/schedule cascade with another account and strategy preserved
Failed final deletion rolls back all child deletions
Linked account/running backtest guards and queued-job removal
Delete older/current research versions, clear current selection and save a later version without number reuse
Pending AI request does not spend during deletion rejection
Deployment replay after deletion returns a conflict instead of recreating the account
Actual spawned Toss quote adapter + loopback HTTP + SQLite: deletion during quote I/O creates no late fill and another account continues
Executable Node confirmation cancel, unavailable mode, duplicate click, old refresh promise, DELETE body/URL, error and button recovery
Standalone manual form absent and research tuning retained
Percentage weights displayed as percent rather than raw fractions

review.functionality: Direct service/HTTP/research/worker source review and regression tests
review.performance: Indexed account child deletes in one transaction and no provider/network I/O in deletion; SQLite write reservation taken before reads
review.code_quality: No schema migration, data remains backward-readable; research request tombstones retain replay and numbering semantics; git diff --check passed
review.security: Owner check before child mutation; existing CSRF guard; explicit confirmation; personal nonproduction nonauthority mode only; fixed SQL statements; no real records deleted or credentials transmitted

limits: Deletion is permanent in the running app; historical backups and research conversation prose are retained
Strategies linked to paper accounts or running backtests cannot be removed until those dependencies are cleared
No real broker or actual AI-provider calls were used in verification
Not a full-repository security scan or public-deployment approval
universe_clarification: A new research strategy defaults to all current US-listed common equities/ADRs/REITs without a user-supplied ticker list. Supported execution logic remains the six implemented price/volume factor families; missing/stale data is excluded visibly.
